Broussard's, a historic French Quarter restaurant established in 1920, has been acquired by QED Hospitality (chef Brian Landry and Emery Whalen) from Creole Cuisine Restaurant Concepts. Despite the ownership change, the restaurant will remain open with no immediate plans for significant changes.

School Street Foods was forced to close indefinitely after a drunk driver crashed into the restaurant in the early morning hours of June 7, 2026, causing significant structural damage. The owners have launched a GoFundMe campaign and say they are focused on recovery and rebuilding.

McHale's Pub opened at 3112 N. Davidson Street in Charlotte's NoDa neighborhood nearly a year ago, founded by owners Kyle Kennedy and Brendan O'Sullivan. The article is a feature profile on the pub's origins and concept rather than a new opening announcement.

Broadway Restaurant Group is planning to open a new restaurant at 560 Harrison Avenue in Boston's South End, taking over the former Gaslight French brasserie space. Local real estate investor Jeff Greenman has acquired the former 3,000-square-foot commercial property at 44 North Street in downtown Hingham, previously home to Hingham Furniture & Design, and plans to open an as-yet-unnamed upscale restaurant. According to Downtown Hingham, the restaurant could open "in the coming years."

data.location: 220 W Lee Dr, Baton Rouge, LA 70808

The restaurant will feature a menu centered on modern sushi and hand rolls, drawing inspiration from the flavors of Asia and Latin America. Owner Dillon Berkabile says the restaurant is expected to open in about two months.

Ten Five Hospitality is planning an unnamed new concept at 3125 M Street NW in Washington, DC, taking over the space previously occupied by Ri Ra Irish Pub, which has been vacant since early 2020. A liquor license placard in the window indicates the future concept will serve alcohol, described as a "Class 'C' tavern" with seating for up to 105 guests. Whether it will be an established Ten Five Hospitality concept or something brand-new remains to be seen.

Kalo NYC, a modern Greek restaurant, is being planned for 1007 Lexington Ave. in the Upper East Side, taking over the former home of Colombian restaurant Maria Mulata. A permit filing with Community Board 8 shows Kalo Lexington LLC is seeking a full liquor license, and the restaurant's official website states "Modern Greek Cuisine Coming Soon." Ownership declined an interview when contacted.

data.location: 306 Pearl Pkwy, Suite 101, San Antonio, TX 78215

No tenant has yet been assigned to the space. The project is part of Pearl's broader plan to introduce seven new restaurant concepts this year.

data.status: anticipates being customer-ready at some point in August
data.short_description: Vienna Lodge Bar & Grill, a log cabin-inspired restaurant, is taking over the 8,654-square-foot space at 2750F Gallows Road previously occupied by Blackfinn Ameripub. Owner Neel Kamal plans to offer classic bar food including wings and burgers alongside Indian options, plus a brunch buffet and potentially a pool table. A precise opening date is not yet available, but Kamal anticipates opening at some point in August.

Luxury accessories brand ZITELLE is relocating its boutique from Church Street to 172 Essex Street in Salem, the former Witch Pix space. The brand is known for premium merino wool beanies, toques, scarves, and other customizable accessories. No opening date for the new location has been specified.

The bar will serve handcrafted gelato, freshly brewed coffee, sweet treats, and confections. The family is aiming to open during the second week of July.

Owner Nancy Fitch launched the business in 2024 after decades of restaurant experience, including running the Pearl Farmers Market for about eight years. The concept quickly found an audience at the farmers market, selling out daily.

data.location: 4800 Burnet Rd, Building D, Suite 450, Austin, TX 78756
data.short_description: Cinque Terre West, an Italian restaurant from celebrated chef Gianbattista Vinzoni and his wife Marlo, plans to open at 4800 Burnet Rd., Building D, Suite 450 in Austin, per public filings. The restaurant will offer all-you-can-eat dining, quick lunches, and grab-and-go options in a space with seating for about 76 guests. An exact opening date is not yet confirmed.

Arble Baking Company is opening a second location in the social area of the new Community First Credit Union branch at 1012 Edgewood Ave S in Murray Hill, Jacksonville. The family-run bakery, founded in 1975, will operate a mini-kitchen featuring its baked goods including cookies, mini cupcakes, cake by the slice, and Sweet Potato Pie. The opening is expected later this year alongside the new credit union branch.

data.status: awaiting final approval from Camden's planning board
data.short_description: Cloud 9 Luxe Waterfront SkyLounge is a proposed rooftop venue planned for the upper deck of an existing parking garage at 10 Delaware Ave. in Camden, NJ, awaiting final approval from Camden's planning board. The venue will feature panoramic views of the Philadelphia skyline, a stage, dance floor, multiple bars, private cabanas, a beach-inspired section with a pool, and a chef-driven menu. Founder Kenneth Walden, who grew up in Camden, envisions it as a premier destination for South Jersey residents.

data.location: 3208 W Indian School Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85017

Owner Raquel Diaz is hoping to open in September, serving beer and cocktails but no food, with karaoke also planned.

data.location: 10580 US-1, Suite 412, Ponte Vedra Beach, FL 32081
data.short_description: House of Coffee, a new coffee shop operated by David and Christine Herron of Herron Real Estate, is nearing completion at 10580 US 1, Suite 412 in Ponte Vedra. The cafe is described as a "community gathering space" with luxury finishes, an open mezzanine, a library setting, and community programming. An exact opening date has not been announced.

Fork to Fit Kitchen is preparing to open a new location at Schertz Station Bldg. 7A at 18406 IH 35 N, Suite 600, per project filings with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation. The concept blends a quick-service restaurant model with a grab-and-go experience, offering macro-balanced meal prep dishes alongside coffees, protein shakes, juice blends, and acai bowls. Construction is expected to move forward once permitting is approved.

Dania Beach Boulevard in downtown Dania Beach. The Caribbean-inspired venue will offer Caribbean cuisine, a hidden speakeasy with craft cocktails, live entertainment, and private cabanas. The restaurant and lounge is expected to open summer of 2026.

A new smoothie food truck, Infinity 8 Smoothies, is coming to Jacksonville based on plan review paperwork submitted for AllThingzWild Botanicals LLC. The owner, Erica Patrick, was not immediately available to discuss the brand. No opening date or menu details have been confirmed.

Juliet, taking over the former KFC building, with franchise owner Nishant "Neil" Meraiya targeting an August 1 debut. Renovations are underway and expected to wrap up in time for the planned opening. The location will become Mt. Juliet's fourth dedicated bagel shop.

The menu will be similar to Marcel's Sarasota location, with some new additions. The space has been purchased by Duclut and interior renovations are underway.

data.status: opening date has not yet been announced

An opening date has not yet been announced, and no menu has been released. Both drinks and food will be served.

Puffles has filed permit applications to open a shop at 1855 S. University Drive in Davie, offering Hong Kong-style egg waffles, premium ice cream, and handcrafted bubble tea. The company website lists no opening date, simply noting the shop is "coming soon." This will be the brand's fourth location in Florida, with additional stores planned for Pembroke Pines and New Jersey.

No opening date has been announced.

Smith Dairy Queens is planning a new location at 2400 E. State Hwy. 21 in Bryan, featuring a drive-thru, patio, and approximately 1,947 square feet of new construction. Construction has not yet begun and an opening timeline has not been confirmed, though construction documents indicate a target completion date of December 2026. The move comes after the company closed its previous Highway 21 location earlier this year and is now relocating along the same corridor.

Pura Vida Miami has signed a lease at Midtown Tampa, a 1.8M sq ft mixed-use development, as one of three new tenants announced this week. The South Florida restaurant brand has grown to more than fifty locations nationwide and offers a menu of sandwiches, wraps, salads, bowls, and all-day breakfast. No opening date has been specified.

CorePower Yoga has signed a lease at Midtown Tampa as one of three new tenants announced this week. The yoga studio chain will join South Florida restaurant Pura Vida Miami and window-treatment retailer The Shade Store at the mixed-use development. No opening date has been specified.

The Shade Store, a window-treatment retailer, has signed a lease at Midtown Tampa as one of three new tenants announced this week. The leases follow a retail joint venture formed by Bromley Companies and Ram Realty Advisors to oversee merchandising and leasing at the $1 billion development. No opening date has been specified.

Barrio Burrito Bar is opening its 24th U.S. location at the Shoppes at Alafia in Riverview this August, serving Tex-Mex fare including burritos, burrito bowls, and tacos. This will be the brand's fifth Florida location, with four more set to open in 2026. Hours will be 11 a.m. to 9 p.m., offering dine-in and takeout.

data.status: first tenants expected to open later this year
data.short_description: J Peters Grill & Bar is coming to Coastal Centre in Conway, SC, as part of the shopping center's redevelopment following its acquisition by Rise Partners in October 2024. Phase one of construction at Coastal Centre began in spring and summer 2026, with the first tenants expected to open later this year. The restaurant is known for its made-from-scratch American cuisine including steaks, ribs, seafood, and signature cocktails.

data.status: still moving forward, with a clearer update expected by fall
data.short_description: Portland Spirit has applied to transform the historic Rose Building at 1020 SW Naito Parkway into a full-service restaurant with a sweeping outdoor patio at Tom McCall Waterfront Park. The project is still moving forward following a leadership transition, with a clearer update expected by fall. Co-founder Dan Yates will remain on the board and continue leading this strategic project.

Jimmy John's is under construction at 5722 Kingston Pike in Knoxville, replacing the former Sonic Drive-In at the corner of Kingston Pike and Gore Road. A spokesperson told Knox News it is still too early to confirm an opening date. The location is owned by franchisees John Kleban and Mike Mayes.

data.location: 10660 Crosstown Pkwy, Port St. Lucie, FL 34987
data.short_description: PM Crosstown LLC has filed permit applications to open a Dunkin' at 10660 S.W. Crosstown Parkway in Port St. Lucie, bringing coffee, breakfast, and baked goods to the community. An opening date has not been announced, and the Dunkin' website lists the location as "coming soon." The location is expected to offer drive-thru service and mobile ordering through the Dunkin' app.

3 Margaritas is preparing to open a new location at the Avenues at Northfield shopping center in Denver, joining Bubba's 33 as tenants for the redeveloped property. The center, formerly known as The Shops at Northfield, is undergoing a multimillion-dollar transformation led by Los Angeles-based Stockdale Capital Partners. No opening date has been announced.

Byblos is set to open a new restaurant at 900 Harrison Avenue in New Orleans' Lakeview neighborhood, taking over the space most recently occupied by Boil & Barrel. Founder Hicham Khodr said the interior is being renovated with a Mediterranean-inspired design, and the location will also feature a full bar and a covered outdoor patio. The restaurant is expected to open around mid-July.

The Perlant, an Atlanta-based private wine and social club, is set to open at 507 12th Ave. S. in The Gulch in fall 2027, marking the brand's first location outside of Atlanta. Founder and CEO Christian Ries confirmed the expansion to WhatNow Nashville, citing Nashville's proximity to Atlanta and its growing wine community as key factors. The club will feature an extensive wine program and a food menu curated to complement the wine selection.

data.location: Ford Road and Berry Street, Westland, MI (exact address not specified)
data.short_description: Scooter's Coffee has broken ground on a new location at the intersection of Ford Road and Berry Street in Westland, MI, with franchisee Anthony Vella of Vella Coffee Group. An exact address and opening date have not been released. The café will serve coffee drinks, teas, lemonades, sandwiches, pastries, and breakfast burritos.

data.location: Ohio, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Missouri, Nebraska, Wisconsin (no specific address)
data.short_description: Fast-casual chicken brand Birdcall is expanding into the Midwest, targeting nearly 100 restaurants across six states — Indiana, Kansas, Missouri, Nebraska, Ohio, and Wisconsin — over the next five years. The Colorado-based company plans to focus on major cities including Cleveland, Cincinnati, Columbus, Indianapolis, Kansas City, Milwaukee, and Omaha. Birdcall currently operates 17 locations across Colorado, Arizona, and Texas, with nearly 20 additional restaurants already in development.

This would mark Piada's first foray into the Leander market.

data.location: 2728 W T C Jester Blvd, Houston, TX 77018
data.short_description: Juanita's Mexican Restaurant at the T.C. Jester Boulevard location in Houston has permanently closed after more than 25 years of operations, having opened in 2000. Jester location and does not affect separately named Juanita's Mexican Kitchen locations in Cypress and Louetta.

Cozy Soup 'n' Burger has closed its doors in New York's NoHo after operating since 1972. The owner cited rising food costs and declining customer traffic as reasons for the closure. The announcement was shared on social media and drew numerous reactions from longtime customers.

data.short_description: Lemongrass Asian Bistro is closing after 28 years of operation, with its final service on June 28. The team hosted farewell events through the weekend including a hibachi Friday and an R&B day party. The owners plan to launch a new nightlife concept called Penthouse: Social Club, with current employees transitioning to the new venture.

data.location: 9668 N Kings Hwy., Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
data.short_description: After25 is a new full-service bar and restaurant concept opening in the former Renegades space in Myrtle Beach, operated by Roger Davisson coming out of retirement. The venue will feature a scratch-made Southern coastal-inspired menu by Chef Michelle Fleming and will only admit guests ages 25 and older. A dress code will be enforced and optional annual memberships are available in three tiers.

data.location: 9928 Mira Mesa Blvd, San Diego, CA 92131
data.short_description: Loving Hut Mira Mesa announced it will permanently close on July 3 after 16 years of serving the San Diego community. The closure follows the shutdown of its North Park location on May 15. Customers were encouraged to visit for a final meal and redeem unused gift cards before the closing date.

data.location: 7494 Santa Monica Blvd, West Hollywood, CA 90046
data.short_description: Breakfast by Salt's Cure officially closed its West Hollywood location after its final service on June 24, ending a 16-year run. The brand will continue operating its other Los Angeles locations and has expanded with a new Silver Lake location near Highland Avenue. The Highland location will be converted into a Breakfast by Salt's Cure, preserving the menu for existing customers.

data.location: 4715 Park Rd, Suite A, Charlotte, NC 28209

data.short_description: Max Strength Fitness is opening its first Charlotte-area franchise at 4715 Park Road, Suite A, owned by Emma Elliot and her husband. The studio will offer private one-on-one 20-minute strength training sessions twice a week, targeting adults who find traditional gyms intimidating. The franchise owners are clinical pharmacist and retirement community management professionals aiming to help adults maintain health as they age.

data.status: hoping to open the restaurant around Aug. 17 for friends and family, and officially start service on Aug. 20
data.short_description: Taan is a new Thai restaurant concept by chef Chanita Chayaluk, who trained at Le Cordon Bleu in Thailand, opening in Humboldt Park in the former Gaoku Sushi space. The menu will feature traditional Thai dishes with Midwest-inspired seasonal flavors, alongside a wine bar with food-paired wines. Chayaluk has submitted a liquor license application and is targeting a friends-and-family opening around August 17.

Haven Hot Chicken is opening a new location at 706 Ninth Street in Durham, developed by brothers John and Tim Enterline through The Enterline Group. The Connecticut-born brand specializes in hand-breaded hot chicken with customizable heat levels and a menu including sandwiches, tenders, wings, and sides. The Durham location will feature a custom mural by artist Amanda "Peep" Bivins inspired by the Bull City.

data.status: preparing to open a third location
data.short_description: Buena Vista Restaurant & Bar is preparing to open its third location in Murray Hill at 212 E 34th St, following recent openings in Midtown and the East Village. Signage is already visible at the upcoming Murray Hill location, according to an Instagram post. No opening date has been announced.

data.status: opening its newest location on July 6
data.short_description: Naked Farmer is opening its first Tennessee location and 10th restaurant overall at The Arcade in downtown Nashville on July 6. The fast-casual brand, founded in Tampa Bay in 2020, specializes in scratch-made meals with locally sourced seasonal ingredients. In Nashville, the restaurant plans to partner with local farmers and food producers to source ingredients.

data.status: anticipated the restaurant being ready to greet and serve visitors in January of 2027
data.short_description: Libro, a Mediterranean-influenced restaurant by John Paul Gagliano, is opening an outpost inside the Memphis Art Museum at 1934 Poplar Ave early next year. The 4,595-square-foot space will feature customized furniture, natural wood, and reclaimed stone, and will have its own entrance and outdoor seating independent of the museum. The Memphis Art Museum is set to open in December 2026, with Libro expected to begin service in January 2027.

Slice House is opening a new location in Brentwood at 2523 Sand Creek Road, franchised by husband and wife Nitin and Mansi Bhatia. Founded by pizzaiolo Tony Gemignani, the fast-casual concept offers regional pizza styles including New York, Detroit, Sicilian, and Grandma slices. The Brentwood location will introduce an exclusive specialty pizza created specifically for this restaurant.

A new Izakaya Osen location appears to be in development in Fullerton at 1050 W Valencia Dr, based on a filing with the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control. The restaurant is part of the Osen Group, a Japanese restaurant collective known for sushi, kushiyaki, and contemporary Japanese dining. No opening timeline has been disclosed, though the restaurant's site indicates a location is slated to open soon at the address.

Dan's Snack Bar is a new breakfast, lunch, and dinner concept from pop-up operator Henryk Kumar, set to open at 406 Church Street in downtown Decatur in the former Mother's Best Fried Chicken space. The restaurant will offer inventive sweet-and-savory dishes served throughout the day and Kumar is also seeking a coffee partner for the existing to-go window. No exact opening date has been announced.

data.location: 201 Avenida Del Mar, San Clemente, CA 92672
data.short_description: Broken Yolk Café is opening a new downtown San Clemente location at 201 Avenida Del Mar, close to the San Clemente Pier, in late 2026. The location is being developed by long-time franchise partner Nick Harris, who currently operates eight Broken Yolk Café locations, and will become the brand's 30th location in Southern California. Construction plans are underway for the new site.

Drink 182, a bar, restaurant, coffee shop, and arcade concept inspired by pop-punk culture, is preparing to open in Ocean Beach at 5049 Newport Avenue in the former Cass Street Bar & Grill and Harry's Taco Shop space. The venue will feature neon lighting, arcade machines, signed memorabilia, and custom artwork, offering a mix of daytime coffee service and nighttime pizza, cocktails, and entertainment. An exact opening date has not been announced.

Ô Quai des Brasseurs, a Quebec-based brewery and restaurant group, is opening a new location on the shores of Lake Masson in Sainte-Marguerite-du-Lac-Masson in the Laurentians. Interior renovations are underway but the project is still awaiting kitchen equipment installation before moving forward. The restaurant is expected to seat about 250 people and employ around 65 staff members.

Pasta Basta is a new Roman-inspired pasta bar opening at 595 Markham Street in Toronto's Mirvish Village, founded by retired Italian diplomat Gianni Bardini. Chef Dario Tomaselli, who also teaches at George Brown College, is leading the kitchen, with a menu focused on classic Roman pasta dishes including carbonara and pesto genovese. The team is still finalizing licenses and awaiting Mirvish Village's official opening.

The relocated shop will continue offering the brand's signature dipped ice cream, handcrafted chocolates, and other sweet treats.

data.short_description: Darbar by Lyari is a new Pakistani restaurant concept potentially coming to 2040 W. Spring Creek Pkwy., Suite 134 in Plano, based on public construction filings indicating a 4,200-square-foot restaurant fit-out. A representative from ZIKR Foods LLC confirmed the restaurant is not ready to share details and that an opening is still several months away. The concept appears connected to the Lyari brand, known for authentic Pakistani and Indian halal cuisine in the Dallas-Fort Worth area.

data.status: targeting August 29 for the opening, pending permits
data.short_description: Layne's Chicken Fingers plans to open at 6934 W. Adams Avenue in Temple, TX, with franchisee Shahroz Khan targeting August 29 for the opening, pending permits. Known for chicken fingers, crinkle-cut fries, and Texas toast, the location is part of a plan to open 29 Layne's locations across the Austin area over 15 years. The first 50 customers may receive a year of free Layne's to celebrate the grand opening.

data.short_description: Earth Coffee, an organic community-focused independent café, plans to expand to Little Elm at 305 E. Eldorado Pkwy., Suite 320. Founder Rajesh R targets a late August to early September 2026 opening, mirroring the timeline of the original Irving location. The menu features organic coffees and teas, South Indian filter coffee, Spanish latte, and fresh made-to-order food.

Kasamar, a forthcoming seaside tavern concept, plans to open at 19 Pier Avenue in Hermosa Beach, taking over the former home of Playa Hermosa Fish & Oyster Co. Restaurant. Co-founder Stephanie De Los Santos confirmed an expected August 2026 opening. The concept will focus on coastal dining centered around seafood, pub-style dishes, and a full beverage program.
